bindings.role: Reference-generation source (not a target frame): it defines the bridge observation deck, the back-facing woman silhouette, the deep-space fleet and the title typography used across the target video.
retained_attributes: Bridge observation deck: large rectangular metal viewport in a thick frame, waist-high sill railing, ribbed reflective metal floor, cold low-key lighting with the interior in shadow.
Woman read from behind as a dark silhouette, dark hair in a tied-back ponytail, long black uniform coat with shoulder tabs and a belt.
Deep-space view: deep blue-black nebula band, dense star field, fleet with two large capital ships flanking the centre and smaller craft scattered around them.
Title packaging: two verbatim uppercase lines in wide letter spacing, cool grey-white that never reaches pure white, subtle surface texture, restrained halo and faint rim glow.
optional_inherited_attributes: Centre-symmetric composition with the woman centred at the sill railing and the window forming a nested frame around the void.
Low camera height at the sill level and the two-line title placed across the upper and centre parts of the frame.
excluded_attributes: The still frame reproduced as a fixed, unchanging anchor across the video.
Both title lines displayed simultaneously over the same moment.
exclusion_reasons: The user asked for a fast-cut trailer with jump, shake, flash and black-frame beats, so the reference is used as a generation reference rather than a locked frame.
The title lines are staggered so each can carry its own entry and reveal animation; both lines remain verbatim in the target video.

developments.visible_change: Outside the viewport the fleet slides out of its drifting scatter into one aligned formation and a small cold jump-charge point of light kindles ahead of it, lifting the light across the deck until the woman's silhouette sharpens; her hands tighten on the sill railing.
developments.outcome: The jump is visibly imminent and the deck is lit for it.

developments.visible_change: The charge core collapses into a strong light burst that floods the whole frame white; the jump impact then slams the bridge, shuddering the structure and the viewport frame, vibrating the floor panels, and throwing the woman forward against the railing where she braces with both arms.
developments.outcome: The jump has fired and the deck is rocked by the impact.

developments.visible_change: Beyond the viewport the nebula and the fleet have been replaced by a corridor of blue-white light rushing past, and the woman pushes herself up off the railing and stands upright at the window, her silhouette rimmed by the streaming light.
developments.outcome: The ship has jumped: the old void is gone, the corridor is the new state, and she has recovered her footing.

shots.content_purpose: Establish the observation deck, the woman at the railing and the fleet in the void, and open the title with its fade-in from the deep-space shadow.
shots.start_state: The woman stands centred at the sill railing with both hands on it and her back to camera; the fleet drifts in a scattered formation inside the nebula band; the first title line is still invisible against the dark part of the nebula.
shots.action: The fleet slides from scatter into one aligned formation and a cold jump-charge point of light kindles ahead of it, raising the light across the deck on her silhouette; her hands tighten on the railing; the first title line fades in out of the deep-space shadow in wide letter spacing with a restrained halo and a faint rim glow.
shots.end_state: The formation is aligned with a small cold charge core ahead of it, the deck light has risen, and the first title line is readable in wide letter spacing.
sound_cues: A faint rising charge whine starts under the fleet's alignment and carries into [Shot 2].

shots.content_purpose: Show the fleet holding in its aligned formation while the charge core swells to its peak, and run the starlight sweep, letter-spacing expansion and afterimage over the title.
shots.cut_reason: The charge that lifts the deck light exists outside the viewport and cannot be seen from the deck-side view; the cut is needed to show where the growing light comes from.
shots.continuity_bridge: The charge core and the raised deck light are already growing at the end of [Shot 1]; [Shot 2] continues the same charge at the same point in its build rather than restarting it.
shots.start_state: The fleet is already in its aligned formation with a small cold core of light burning ahead of it, brighter than at the start of [Shot 1]; the first title line is lit on the frame.
shots.action: The core swells and begins to drag the surrounding stars sideways; a sweep of starlight crosses the title letters from left to right and illuminates them as it passes; the letter spacing expands and a faint afterimage trails behind the letters.
shots.end_state: The core is at its brightest, the stars are lengthening into the first streaks, and the title letters are fully lit with expanded spacing and a trailing afterimage.
sound_cues: The charge whine keeps climbing with the swelling core and runs into [Shot 3].

shots.content_purpose: Trigger the jump: the charged core's light spikes through the viewport into a strong light burst that floods the deck and the title.
shots.start_state: The core is at peak brightness outside; the interior is still lit only by it; the first title line is lit on the frame.
shots.action: The core's light spikes through the viewport into a strong light burst that floods the whole frame white; the deck is blown out, the woman's silhouette is swallowed by the white, and the halos and rim glow on the letters flare and blow out with it.
shots.end_state: The frame is entirely white, with the deck, the woman and the title all lost inside the burst.
sound_cues: One sharp high crack cuts through the rising whine on the first pure-white frame of the burst.

shots.content_purpose: Land the jump impact on the bridge: the black-frame occlusion clears onto a violently shaking deck with the woman thrown against the railing.
shots.cut_reason: The burst and its impact are one continuous event, but the impact cannot be read while the frame is still flooded white; the locked black-frame beat is the point where the white peak can be replaced by the shaken deck.
shots.continuity_bridge: The burst's white peak is fully occluded by the black frame and the deck's jolt begins under the lifted black as the direct result of that same burst, so the impact continues the same jump event instead of starting a new one.
shots.start_state: The frame is black; behind it the burst has just peaked and the deck has just been struck, not yet visible.
shots.action: The black frame holds briefly, then lifts onto the deck as the jump impact lands: the whole structure shudders violently, the viewport frame and the sill railing shake, the ribbed floor panels vibrate, and the woman is thrown forward against the railing and braces there with both arms while her body jolts with the deck; outside, the nebula band and the ships smear into long streaks.
shots.end_state: The deck is still trembling, the woman is braced low against the railing, and the void outside has smeared into long streaks.
sound_cues: A deep sub-bass boom lands with the deck's first visible jolt, followed by a low-frequency rattle of the frame and floor panels, with the deck hum running underneath.

shots.content_purpose: Complete the jump: the aligned fleet is drawn into a single point of light that stretches into the corridor of light.
shots.start_state: The ships of the formation are still streaking sideways in the void.
shots.action: The ships are drawn together into one point of light that stretches into a blue-white corridor rushing toward the camera; the ship shapes and the nebula band elongate into streaks before the corridor light fills the frame.
shots.end_state: The blue-white corridor fills the frame; the nebula and the fleet are gone.
sound_cues: The wide rushing roar of the corridor begins here and continues across the cut into [Shot 6].

shots.content_purpose: Show the new state after the jump, with the corridor outside and the woman standing, and reveal the second title line.
shots.cut_reason: The rush of the corridor cannot be shown at the same time as the woman's recovery from the jolt taken in [Shot 4]; the black frame separates the exterior jump from the deck's new state and carries the second title reveal.
shots.continuity_bridge: The corridor roar is already running at the end of [Shot 5] and continues under the lifted black; the same rushing light is now seen from the deck side as she rises from the brace she took in [Shot 4].
shots.start_state: The frame is black over the ongoing corridor roar; the woman is still braced low against the railing from the impact.
shots.action: The black lifts onto the deck: the shaking has stopped and the viewport is filled by the rushing blue-white corridor streaming past; the woman pushes herself up off the railing and stands upright at the window, still facing it, her silhouette rimmed by the streaming light; the second title line reveals itself out of the dark of the frame while its letter spacing expands, with a soft afterimage behind the letters and a faint glow modulating across them.
shots.end_state: The woman stands upright at the window against the streaming corridor light, and the second title line is fully readable in wide letter spacing.
sound_cues: The corridor roar stays level under the whole shot and the final score chord decays across the last frame.

constraints: generate_audio is enabled, so the piece needs a generated soundtrack.
No dialogue, narration or lyrics are specified and none are added.
No source audio exists in the reference set, so no audio is copied or referenced.
The score must serve the faster trailer pacing and must never lengthen a shot.
audio_plan.auditory_focus: The jump itself: the rising charge whine and the single deep boom of the impact, set against the hard-cut rhythm.
audio_plan.continuous_bed: A low bridge-deck hum with a faint ventilation undertone that deepens into a sub-bass shudder while the deck is struck, then gives way to the wide rushing roar of the jump corridor from [Shot 5] onward.

key_sound_events.trigger: The jump-charge core swelling to its brightest ahead of the aligned formation.
key_sound_events.sound: A thin rising charge whine that climbs with the core.
key_sound_events.sync: The whine keeps climbing through the cut into [Shot 3] and is cut off by the burst's crack on its first pure-white frame.

key_sound_events.trigger: The charge core's light spiking through the viewport into the strong light burst.
key_sound_events.sync: The crack lands exactly on the first pure-white frame of the burst.

key_sound_events.trigger: The jump impact slamming the bridge after the black frame.
key_sound_events.sound: A deep sub-bass boom with a low-frequency rattle of the viewport frame and floor panels.
key_sound_events.sync: The boom lands on the first visible frame after the black frame, together with the deck's first jolt.

music_decision.function: Unify the fast hard-cut trailer pacing and carry the epic scale across the cuts without slowing the piece.
music_decision.tempo_energy_basis: A moderate-fast steady pulse with one accent per hard cut, matching the roughly 1.4 to 3.4 second shot spacing and the single large impact at the jump.
music_decision.dynamic_arc: Sparse and low under the title's fade-in, adding density as the charge builds, peaking at the burst and the impact, then holding one wide sustained chord through the corridor and decaying at the end.

audio_plan.mix_priority: The jump impact and the charge build stay on top; the score sits under them and accents the hard cuts; the deck ambience and the corridor roar stay lowest so they never mask the impacts.
audio_plan.ending_state: The corridor roar and one wide sustained score chord hold level as the final image holds, and the chord decays across the last frame so the ending reads as arrived rather than fading out early.

uncertainties.issue: The reference set contains a single still image, so it cannot evidence the bridge shake, the light burst, the black frames, the jump impact or any text animation.
uncertainties.impact: Those beats are treated as user-locked additions and are never claimed as observed source behaviour.

uncertainties.issue: Title glow strength, surface texture and animation timing cannot be verified from a static frame; only the wide letter spacing and general cold tone are visible.
uncertainties.impact: The prompt keeps the glow restrained and the colour cool grey-white, following the user's wording rather than the still image.

uncertainties.issue: It is unresolved whether the fleet jumps away and leaves the woman's deck behind, or whether her ship jumps together with the formation.
uncertainties.impact: The plan treats the deck's shake as her ship jumping with the fleet, so the corridor appears both from the exterior side in [Shot 5] and through the viewport in [Shot 6].

uncertainties.issue: A brief black frame is listed once as a beat and once as a title effect, so the intended number of black frames is unspecified.
uncertainties.impact: The plan uses two brief black frames, one as the burst-to-impact insert in [Shot 4] and one over the second title reveal in [Shot 6]; if only one is wanted, the [Shot 6] black frame should be removed.

uncertainties.issue: No audio direction and no audio asset were supplied.
uncertainties.impact: The score, impacts and ambience are open design; no audio copying or referencing is claimed anywhere in the plan.
